**Finding: MINCOMMIT — Compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume commitment on Sparkling:

- **§ 11 (p0084)** — fees are payable only "as set out in the Fee Schedule," with no committed spend or volume.
- **§ 2 (p0028)** — additional fees arise only if Sparkling elects to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations, i.e. usage-based.
- **§ 10 (p0065)** — maintenance is a "renewable one-year term," not a multi-year committed term.
- **§ 17(b) (p0118)** — Sparkling may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice, so even the annual maintenance term carries an exit.

The copy/location limits in § 3 are licence-scope restrictions, not purchase commitments, so they are not flagged here. No redline proposed. One diligence note for the deal team: Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule) is referenced but not reproduced in this document, so we should confirm it contains no committed seat, location or maintenance-year minimums before signature.
